But what about evacuating in the case of an emergency? In general, safety protocols are put in place to ensure everyone makes it to the nearest exit or safe zone, divided in a way that reduces traffic and delays. Even so, it has been observed countless times that during times of an emergency, regardless of how prepared one may be, panic takes over. In these moments, institutions are obliged to make sure protocols are followed and no-one is disadvantaged due to a physical challenge or disability.
